label: sec:transcendence-signatures-intro
html: Because the topological mass formula evaluates particle masses through Bloch–Wigner hyperbolic volumes \mathrm{Vol}(S^3 \setminus K), the Borel–Zagier transcendence properties of mixed Tate periods imply concrete falsifiability signatures: any two particles whose assigned link complements have \mathbb{Q}-linearly independent Bloch-group classes must exhibit an irrational, non-Diophantine mass ratio, whereas algebraically dependent classes enforce exact rational linear relations among logarithmic mass ratios.
